text.body: <1> vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntabhūṣaṇasāraḥ śrīlakṣmīramaṇaṃ naumi gaurīramaṇarūpiṇam| sphoṭarūpaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ jagadetad vivarttate || 1 || aśeṣaphaladātāraṃ bhavābdhitaraṇe tarim| śeṣāśeṣārthalābhārtha prārthaye śeṣabhūṣaṇam || 2|| pāṇinyādimunīn praṇamya pitaraṃ raṅgojibhaṭṭabhidhaṃ dvaitadhvāntanivāraṇādiphalikāṃ pumbhāvavāgdevatām| ḍhuṇḍhiṃ gautamajaiminīyavacanavyākhyātṛbhirdūṣitān siddhāntānupapattibhiḥ prakaṭaye teṣāṃ vaco dūṣaye || 3|| natvā gaṇeśapādābjaṃ gurūnatha sarasvatīm| śrīkauṇḍabhaṭṭaḥ kurve'haṃ vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇam||* prāripsitapratibandhakopaśamanāya kṛtaṃ śrīphaṇismaraṇarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ śiṣyaśikṣārthaṃ nibadhnan cikīrṣitaṃ pratijānīte- phaṇibhāṣitabhāṣyābdheḥ śabdakaustubha ud‌dhṛtaḥ| tatra nirṇīta evā'rthaḥ saṅ‌kṣepeṇeha kathyate || 1|| ud‌dhṛta iti| atra `asmābhiḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| `bhāṣyābdheḥ śabdakaustubha ud‌dhṛtaḥ' ityuktistu śabdakaustubhoktānāmarthānāmādhunikotprekṣitatvanirāsāya| anyathā tanmūlakasyā'sya granthasyāpyādhunikotprekṣitāsāratvāpattau pāṇinīyānāmanupādeyatāpatteḥ|`tatra nirṇita' ityuktirito'pyadhikaṃ jijñāsubhiḥ śabdakaustubhe draṣṭavyamiti dhvanayitum || 1|| <1-0> atha dhātvarthanirṇayaḥ <1-1>dhātvākhyātārthaviṣaye vaiyākaraṇamatam pratijñātamāha- phalavyāpārayordhāturāśraye tu tiṅaḥ smṛtāḥ| phale pradhānaṃ vyāpārastiṅarthastu viśeṣaṇam || 2 || dhāturityatra smṛta iti vacanavipariṇāmenā'nvayaḥ| <1-1-1>dhātvarthaḥ phalam-viklittyādi| vyāpārastu bhāvanābhidhā-sādhyatvenā'bhidhīyamānā kriyā| uktañca vākyapadīye- `yāvat siddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenā'bhidhīyate| āśritakramarūpatvāt sā kriyetya'bhidhīyate|| iti || na ca sādhyatvenā'bhidhāne mānābhāvaḥ, `pacati, pākaḥ, karoti, kṛtiḥ' ityādau dhātvarthāvagamāviśeṣe'pi kriyāntarākāṅ‌kṣānākāṅ‌kṣayordarśanasyaiva mānatvāt| tathā ca kriyāntarākāṅ‌kṣā'nutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpaṃ sādhyatvam| tadrūpavattvamasattvabhūtatvam| etadevā''dāya `asattvabhūto bhāvaśca tiṅpadairabhidhīyate|' iti vākyapadīyamiti draṣṭavyam| ayañca vyāpāraḥ phūtkāratvādhaḥsantāpanatvayatnatvāditattadrūpeṇa vācyaḥ, pacatītyādau tattatprakārakabodhasyā'nubhavasiddhatvāt| na ca nānārthatāpattiḥ, `tadādi'nyāyena buddhiviśeṣādeḥ śakyatāvacchedakānāmanugamakasya sattvāt| ākhyāte kriyaikatvavyavasthā'pi avacchedakabuddhiviśeṣaikyamādāyaiva| uktañca vākyapadīye- `guṇabhūtairavayavaiḥ samūhaḥ kramajanmanām| buddhayā prakalpitā'bhedaḥ kriyeti vyapadiśyate||' iti | <1-1-2> tiṅarthaḥ dhātvarthaṃ nirūpya tiṅ‌rthamāha- āśraye tviti-phalāśraye, vyāpārāśraye cetyarthaḥ| phalāśrayaḥ karmma, vyāpārāśrayaḥ karttā| tatra phalavyāpārayordhātulabhyatvānna tiṅastadaṃśe śaktiḥ, anyalabhyatvāt| śaktatāvacchedakaṃ cāśrayatvaṃ tattacchaktiviśeṣarūpamiti subarthanirṇaye vakṣyate| <1-1-2-1>kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ākhyātārthatve pramāṇam nanvanayorākhyātārthatve kiṃ mānam| pratīte rlakṣaṇayā ākṣepāt prathamāntapadādvā sambhavāditi cet- atrocyate-`laḥ karmmaṇi ca bhāve cā'karmmakebhyaḥ'(pāo sūo 3-4-69) iti sūtrameva mānam| atra hi cakārāt 'karttari kṛt'(pāo sūo 3-4-68) iti sūtroktaṃ karttarītyanukṛṣyate| bodhakatārūpāṃ tibādiśaktiṃ tatsthānitvena kalpite lakāre prakalpya lakārāḥ karmaṇi karttari cānena vidhīyante, nakāravisargādiniṣṭhāṃ karmakaraṇādibodhakatāśaktimādāya śasādividhānavat| na ca sūtre kartṛkarmapade kartṛtvakarmatvapare| tathāca kartṛtvam-kṛtiḥ, karmmatvañca phalamevārtho'stviti śaṅ‌k‌yam, phalavyāpārayordhātulabhyatvena lakārasya punastatra śaktikalpanā'yogāt| atha darśanāntarīyarītyā vyāpārasya dhātvarthatvābhāvāttatra lakāravidhiḥ syāditi cet, tarhi kṛtāmapi kartṛkarmmādivācitvaṃ na siddhayet, `karttari kṛt' iti ca`laḥ karmmaṇi' ityanena tulyayogakṣemam| api ca mīmāṃsakānāṃ kṛtāmivā''khyātānāmapi kartṛvācitvamastu, bhāvanāyā evā''kṣepeṇa kṛdādivat pratītisambhave vācyatvaṃ mā'stu| tathā sati prādhānyaṃ tasyā na syāditi cenna, `ghaṭamānaya' ityādāvākṣiptavyakterapi prādhānyavadupapatteḥ| pacatītyādau pākaṃ karotīti bhāvanāyā vivaraṇadarśanādvācyatvamiti cenna, pākā'nukūlavyāpāravataḥ kartturapi vivaraṇaviṣayatvā'viśeṣāt| na ca kartturvivaraṇaṃ tātparyā'rthavivaraṇam‌,pākaṃ karotītyaśabdā'rthakarmatvavivaraṇavat, itaretarayogadvandve samuccayāṃ'śavivaraṇavadvā na tadarthanirṇākamiti vācyam, bhāvanāyāmapi tulyatvāt| kiñca, `pacati devadattaḥ' ityatrā'bhedānvayadarśanāttadanurodhena kartturvācyatvamāvaśyakam `paktā devadattaḥ' itivat| nacā'bhedabodhe samānavibhaktikatvaṃ niyāmakam, taccātra nāstīti vācyam, `somena yajeta' `stokaṃ pacati' `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādāvapyabhedabodhā'nāpatteḥ| naca lakṣaṇayā kartturuktatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam, piṅgākṣyādiyaugikānāmapi dravyavācitvā'nāpatteḥ| evaṃ vaiśvadevītyāditaddhitānāmapi, `anekamanyapadārthe' `sā'sya devatā' ityanuśāsanena piṅge akṣiṇī yasyāḥ, viśve devā devatā asyā iti vigrahadarśanāt pradhānaṣaṣṭhayarthe eva anuśāsanalābhāt| tathāca `aruṇayā piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti' iti vākye dravyā'nukterāruṇyasya svavākyopāttadravye evā'nvayapratipādakā'ruṇādhikaraṇocchedā''pattiḥ, dravyavācakatvasādhakamūlayukteḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyoktarītyopapatteriti prapāñcitaṃ vistareṇa bṛhad‌vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇe| tiṅaḥ iti| bodhakatārūpā śaktistiṅ‌kṣvevetyabhipretyedam| <1-1-3>vākye bhāvanāyāḥ eva mukhyaviśeṣyatvam padārthaṃ nirūpya vākyārthaṃ nirūpayati-pale ityādi| viklittyādi phalaṃ prati| <1-1-3-1>tiṅarthānām viśeṣaṇatvena anvayapratipādanam tiṅarthaḥ-karttṛkarmasaṃkhyākālāḥ| tatra karttṛkarmaṇī phalavyāpārayorviśeṣaṇe| <1-1-3-1-1>tiṅarthasaṃkhyāyāḥ kutrānvaya iti nirdhāraṇam saṃkhyā karttṛpratyaye kartari, karmapratyaye karmaṇi, samānapratyayopāttatvāt| tathāca `ākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakabodhaṃ prati ākhyātajanyakarttṛkarmopasthirhetuḥ' iti kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitaḥ| <1-1-3-1-1-1>tatra naiyāyikamatanirāsaḥ naiyāyikādīnāmākhyātārthasaṅkhyāyāḥ prathamāntārthe evā'nvayāt `ākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirhetuḥ' iti kāryakaraṇabhāvo vācyaḥ| so'pi `candra iva mukhaṃ dṛśyate' `devadatto bhuktvā vrajati'ityādau candraktvārthayorākhyātārthānanvayāditarā'viśeṣaṇatvaghaṭita ityatigauravam| idamapi kartṛkarmaṇorākhyātārthatve mānamiti spaṣṭaṃ bhūṣaṇe| <1-1-3-1-2>tiṅarthakālasya vpāpāraviśeṣaṇatvam kālastu vyāpāre viśeṣaṇam, tathāhi -`varttamāne laṭ' (pāo sūo 3-2-123) ityatrā'dhikārād dhātoriti labdham| tacca dhātvarthaṃ vadat prādhānyād vyāpārameva grāhayatīti tatraiva tadanvayaḥ| naca saṅ‌khyāvat karttṛkarmaṇorevānvayaḥ śaṅ‌kyaḥ,atītabhāvanāke karttari pacatītyāpatteḥ,apākṣīdityanāpatteśca| pākānārambhadaśāyāṃ kartṛsattve pakṣyatītyanāpatteśca| nāpi phale tadanvayaḥ,phalā'nutpattidaśāyāṃ vyāpārasattve, pacatītyanāpatteḥ, pakṣyatītyāpatteścetyavadheyam| nacā''mavātajaḍīkṛtakalebarasyotthānā'nukūlayatnasattvāduttiṣṭhatīti prayogāpattiḥ, parayatnasyājñānādaprayogāt| kiñcicceṣṭādinā tadavagatau ca, ayamuttiṣṭhati, śaktyabhāvāt phalantu na jāyate iti lokapratīteriṣṭatvāt| evañca tiṅartho viśeṣaṇameva, bhāvanaiva pradhānam| yadyapi prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasyaiva prādhānyamanyatra dṛṣṭam, tathā'pi `bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' iti (nio ao 2 kha 2) niruktāt, bhūvādisūtrādisthakriyāprādhānyabodhakabhāṣyācca dhātvarthabhāvanāprādhānyamadhyavasīyate| <1-1-3-2>ākhyātārthakartṛkarmaṇoḥ prādhānyavādiviśiṣṭādvaitimatakhaṇḍanam apica, ākhyātārthaprādhānye tasya devadattādibhiḥ samamabhedānvayāt prathāmāntasya prādhānyāpattiḥ| tathāca, `paśya mṛgo dhāvati' ityatra bhāṣyasiddhaikavākyatā na syāt, prathamāntamṛgasya dhāvanakriyāviśeṣyasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmmatvāpattau dvitīyāpatteḥ| nacaivamaprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyācchatṛprasaṅgaḥ, evamapi dvitīyāyā durvāratvena `paśya mṛgaḥ' ityādivākyasyaivā'sambhavāpatteḥ| na ca paśyetyatra tamiti karmādhyāhāryyam,vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt, utkaṭadhāvanakriyāviśeṣasyaiva darśanakarmatayā'nvayasya pratipipādayiṣitatvāt, adhyāhāre'nanvayāpatteśca| <1-1-3-3> prathamāntamukhyaviśeṣyatvavādinaiyāyikamatakhaṇḍanam evañca, `bhāvanāprakārakabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam' iti naiyāyikoktaṃ nādaraṇīyam| kintu `ākhyātārthakartṛprakārakabodhe dhātujanyopasthitirbhāvanātvāvacchinnaviṣayatayā kāraṇam' iti kāryakāraṇabhāvo draṣṭavyaḥ| bhāvanāprakārakabodhaṃ prati tu kṛjjanyopasthitivad dhātvarthabhāvanopasthitirapi hetuḥ, `pasya mṛgo dhāvati', `pacati bhavati' ityādyanurodhāditi dik| itthañca pacatītyatraikā''śrayikā pākā'nukūlā bhāvanā| pacyate ityatraikā''śrayā yā viklittistadanukūlā bhāvaneti bodhaḥ| devadattādipadaprayoge tvākhyātārthakartrādibhistadarthasyā'bhedā'nvayaḥ| `ghaṭo naśyati'ityatra ghaṭā'bhinnā''śrayako nāśā'nukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| sa ca vyāpāraḥ pratiyogitvaviśiṣṭanāśasāmagrīsamavadhānam| ata eva tasyāṃ satyāṃ naśyati, tadatyaye 'naṣṭaḥ' tadbhāvitve naṅkṣyatīti prayogaḥ| `devadatto jānāti', icchatī'tyādau ca devadattā'bhinnā''śrayako jñānecchādyanukūlo varttamāno vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| sa cāntata āśrayataivetirītyohyam || 2 || <1-2> ākhyātārthakartṛkarmaṇoḥ tātparyagrāhakāḥ nanvākhyātasya kartṛkarmaśaktatve `pacati' ityatrobhayabodhāpattiḥ| kartṛmātrabodhavat karmamātrasyāpi bodhāpattirityatastātparyagrāhakamāha- phalavyāpārayostatra phale taṅ‌yak‌ciṇādayaḥ| vyāpāre śap‌śnamādyāstu dyotayantyāśrayā'nvayam || 3 || taṅādayaḥ phale āśrayā'nvayaṃ dyotayanti, phalā'nvayyāśrayasya karmatvāt| taddyotakāḥ-karmadyotakāḥ| vyāpārā'nvayyāśrayasya kartṛtvāt| tad‌dyotakāḥ-kartṛdyotakā iti samudāyārthaḥ| dyotayanti-tātparyyaṃ grāhayanti || 3 || nanvevaṃ `kramādamuṃ nārada ityabodhi sa' ityādau, pacyate odanaḥ svayameva' ityādau ca vyabhicāraḥ, karmaṇaḥ karttṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ karttari lakāre sati, `karmavat‌ karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (pāo sūo 3-1-87) ityatideśena yagātmanepadaciṇ‌ciṇvadiṭāmatideśādyagādisattve'pi karttureva bodhāt, vyāpāre evāśrayānvayācca| abodhītyatrāpi budhyateḥ karttari luṅ‌, tasya "dīpajana" (pāo sūo 3-1-61) iti ciṇ, `ciṇo luk' (pāo sūo 6-4-104) iti tasya lug iti sādhanādityāśaṅkāyāmāha- utsargo'yaṃ karmakartṛviṣayādau viparyyayāt| tasmād yathocitaṃ jñeyaṃ dyotakatvaṃ yathāgamam || 4 || karmakartṛviṣayādau-pacyate odanaḥ svayameva, ityādau| atra hyekaudanābhinnāśrayakaḥ pākānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| `kramāt' iti ādipadagrahyam| atra `sāmānyaviśeṣajñānapūrvaka ekanāradaviṣayakajñānā'nukūlaḥ kṛṣṇābhinnāśrayako'tīto vyāpāraḥ' iti bodhaḥ| yathocitamiti-sakarmakadhātusamabhivyāhṛtabhāvasādhāraṇavidhivedheyaciṇyagādi karmadyotakamiti bhāvaḥ || 4 || <1-3>liṅatiriktalaḍādyante bhāvanāyāḥ avācyatvavādiprābhākaramatakhaṇḍanam evaṃ sūcīkaṭāhanyāyena sopapattikaṃ vākyārthamupavarṇya `phalavyāpārayoḥ' iti pratijñātaṃ dhātorvyāpāravācitvam, laḍādyante bhāvanāyā avācyatvaṃ vadataḥ prābhākarādīn prati vyavasthāpayati- <1-3-1> bhāvanā-kriyā-vyāpāraḥ-utpādanā ityeteṣām paryāyatā vyāpāro bhāvanā saivotpādanā saiva ca kriyā| kṛño'karmmakatāpatterna hi yatno'rtha iṣyate || 5 || pacati-pākamutpādayati, pākānukūlā bhāvanā, tādṛśyutpādanā iti vivaraṇād vivriyamāṇasyāpi tadvācakateti bhāvaḥ| vyāpārapadaṃ ca phūtkārādīnāmayatnānāmapi phūtkāratvādirūpeṇa vācyatāṃ dhvanayitumuktam| ata eva pacatītyatra adhaḥsantāpanatva-phūtkāratva-cullyuparidhāraṇatvayatnatvādibhirbodhaḥ sarvasiddhaḥ| <1-3-2> kṛtitvasya śakyatāvacchedakatvanirāsaḥ nacaivameṣāṃ śakyatā'vacchedakatve gauravāpattyā kṛtitvameva tadavacdhedakaṃ vācyam, `ratho gacchati' jānātītyādau ca vyāpāratvādiprakārakabodho lakṣaṇayeti naiyāyikarītiḥ sādhvī, śakyatā'vacchedakatvasyāpi lakṣyatā'vacchedakatvavad guruṇi sambhavāt, tayorvaiṣamye bījābhāvāt| <1-3-2-1> karotināvivaraṇāt ākhyātasya yatnārthatvamiti matasya khaṇḍanam naca pacati-pākaṃ karotīti yatnārthakakarotinā vivaraṇād yatna evā''khyātārtha iti vācyam| `ratho gamanaṃ karoti'bījādinā aṅkuraḥ kṛtaḥ' iti darśanāt kṛño yatnārthakatāyā asiddheḥ| <1-3-3> bhāvanāyāḥ avācyatve doṣapradarśanam <1-3-3-1> bhāvanāyāḥ avācyatve ghaṭo bhavatītyatra ghaṭapadāta-dvitīyāpattiḥ kiñca, bhāvanāyā avācyatve ghaṭaṃ bhāvayatītyatreva ghaṭo bhavatītyatrāpi dvitīyā syāt| nacātra ghaṭasya kartṛtvena tatsaṃjñayā karmmasaṃjñāyā bādhānna dvitīyeti vācyam, anugatakartṛtvasya tvanmate durvacatvena ghaṭasyākartṛtvāt| kṛtyāśrayatvasya, kārakacakraprayoktṛtvasya vā ghaṭādāvabhāvāt, dhātvarthānukūlavyāpārāśrayatvasya ca kārakamātrātivyāpakatvāt| <1-3-3-2> bhāvanāyāḥ avācyatve sakarmakatvākarmakatvavyavasthānāpattiḥ apica bhāvanāyā avācyatve dhātūnāṃ sakarmmakatvākarmmakatvavibhāga ucchinnaḥ syāt| `svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvam', `svārthavyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalavācakatvam' vā sakarmmakatvaṃ bhāvanāyā vācyatvamantareṇāsambhavi| `anyatamatvaṃ tattvam' iti cenna, ekasyaivārthabhedenākarmmakatva-sakarmmakatvadarśanāt| tadetadabhisandhāyāha-kṛña iti| <1-3-3-3> vyāpārasya avācyatve phalamātrasya dhātvarthatve doṣapradarśanam ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-vyāpārā'vācyatvapakṣe phalamātramartha iti phalitam| tathāca karotītyādau yatnapratītestanmātraṃ vācyamabhyupeyam| tathāca `yatī prayatne' itivat phalasthānīyayatnavācakatvāviśeṣādakarmmakatāpattiruktarītyā durvvāreti| tathāca `na hi yatnaḥ' ityatra phalasthānīyatveneti śeṣaḥ| kṛña iti-dhātumātropalakṣaṇam, sarveṣāmapyakarmmakatā, sakarmmakatā vā syāditi bhāvaḥ| <1-3-4>dhātoḥ kevalavyāpāravācitvanirāsaḥ athavā, `vyāpāro bhāvanā' ityardhena vyāpārasya vācyatvaṃ prasādhya phalāṃśasyāpi tat sādhayan naiyāyikābhyupagataṃ jānāti-karotyādeḥ kevalajñāna-yatnādikriyāmātravācitvaṃ dūṣayati-kṛña iti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-phalāṃśasyāvācyatve vyāpāra eva dhātvarthaḥ syāt| tathāca svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvādirūpasakarmmatvocchedāpattiḥ| naca kṛñādau sakarmakatvavyavahāro bhākta iti naiyāyikoktaṃ yuktam, vyāvahārasya bhāktatve'pi karmmaṇi lakārāsambhavāt| vyavakīrṇeyamaśaktairabhidhātṛbhiḥ| anityadarśināṃ tvasmin vāde buddhiviparyyayaḥ || iti || avācakaḥ-abodhakaḥ, buddhiviparyyayaḥ-ete eva vācakā nānye iti viparyyaya ityarthaḥ| kiñca vinigamanāvirahād bhāṣāyāmapi śaktiḥ| naca tāsāṃ nānātvaṃ doṣaḥ, saṃskṛtavanmahārāṣṭrādibhāṣāyāḥ sarvatraikatvena pratyekaṃ vinigamanāvirahatadavasthyāt| kiñcānupūrvī pade'vacchedikā| sā ca paryyāyeṣviva pāpajananabodhanāya "nāsādhubhiḥ" iti niṣedhaḥ| tathāca puṇyajananayogyatvaṃ sādhutvam| pāpajananayogyatvamasādhutvam| tatra janakatā'vacchedikā ca jātiḥ| tajjñāpakañca kośādi, vyākaraṇādi ca| evameva atiriktaśaktigrahopāyamāha- sambandhiśabde sambandho yogyatāṃ prati yogyatā|| samayād yogyatāsaṃvinmātāputrādiyogavat || 39 || sambandho viṣayaḥ| yogyatāṃ prati yogyatā-sambandhiśabdaṃ prati yogyatā viṣaya iti| samayāt-vyavahārāt, yogyatāsaṃvit-śaktigrahaḥ| ghaṭapadamatra yogyametatsambandhīti vyavahārāt, sā grāhyetyarthaḥ || 39 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre śaktinirṇayaḥ || 6 || <7> atha nañarthanirṇayaḥ| <7-1> āropitatvaṃ nañdyotyam nañarthamāha- nañ‌samāse cāparasya prādhānyāt sarvanāmatā || āropitatvaṃ nañ‌dyotyaṃ na hyaso'pyatisarvavat || 40 || nañ‌samāse aparasya-uttarapadārthasya prādhānyāt sarvanāmatā siddhyatīti śeṣaḥ| ata eva āropitatvameva, nañ‌dyotyamiti--abhyupeyamiti śeṣaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-`asarvaḥ' ityādau `āropitaḥ sarvaḥ' ityarthe sarvaśabdasya prādhānyābādhāt sarvanāmatā siddhayati| anyathā `atisarvaḥ' ityatreva sā na syāt, `ghaṭo nāsti' ityādāvabhāvaviṣayakabodhe tasya viśeṣyatāyā eva darśanāt| asmadrītyā ca sa ārtho bodho mānasaḥ| tathāca `asarvasmai ityādyasiddhiprasaṅgo neti| atra cāropitatvam-āropaviṣayatvam| āropamātramartho viṣayatvaṃ saṃsarga iti niṣkarṣaḥ| dyotyatvoktirnipātānāṃ dyotakatvamabhipretya || 40 || <7-2> abhāvaḥ nañartha iti pakṣāntaropapādanam `ghaṭo nāsti' `abrāhmaṇaḥ ityādāvāropabodhasya sarvānubhavaviruddhatvāt pakṣāntaramāha- abhāvo vā tadartho'stu bhāṣyasya hi tadāśayāt| viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyo vā nyāyatastvavadhāryyatām || 41 || tadarthaḥ-nañarthaḥ arthapadaṃ dyotyatva-vācyatvapakṣayoḥ sādhāraṇyena kīrttanāya| <7-2-1> abhāvaḥ nañartha iti pakṣe bhāṣyaprāmāṇyam bhāṣyasyeti-tathāca nañ‌sūtre mahābhāṣyam-"nivṛttapadārthakaḥ" iti, nivṛttaṃ padārtho yasya "napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ" (pāo sūo 3-1-114) iti ktaḥ| abhāvārthaka ityarthaḥ| yattu-nivṛttaḥ padārtho yasminnityarthaḥ| sādṛśyādinā'dhyāropitabrāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyādayo'rthā yasyetyartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ, tanna, adhyāropitabrāhmaṇyasya kṣatriyādernañavācyatvāt| anyathā sādṛśyāderapi vācyatāpatteḥ| <7-2-2> sādṛśyādīnām nañarthatvābhāvapratipādanam yattu- tatsādṛśyamabhāvaśca tadanyatvaṃ tadalpatā| aprāśastyaṃ virodhaśca nañarthāḥ ṣaṭ‌ prakīrttitāḥ|| iti paṭhitvā abrāhmaṇaḥ, apāpam, anaśvaḥ, anudarā kanyā, apaśavo vā anye go'śvebhyaḥ, adharma ityudāharanti| tattvārthikārthamabhipretyeti spaṣṭamanyatra| viśeṣaṇamiti-pratiyoginīti śeṣaḥ| tathācāsarvāpade sarvanāmatā| "anekamanyapadārthe" "sevyate'nekayā sannatāpāṅgayā" ityādāvekaśabdārthaprādhānyādekavacananiyamaḥ| `abrāhmaṇaḥ ityādāvuttarapadārthaprādhānyāt tatpuruṣatvam| `atvaṃ bhavasi' `anahaṃ bhavāmi' ityādau puruṣavacanādivyavasthā copapadyate| anyathā tvadabhāvo madabhāva itivadabhāvāṃśe yuṣmadasmadoranvayena yuṣmatsāmānādhikaraṇyasya tiṅ‌kṣvasattvāt puruṣavyavasthā na syāt| asmanmate ca bhedapratiyogitvavadabhinnāśrayikā bhavanakriyetyanvayāt, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nānupapannamiti bhāvaḥ| viśeṣyo veti-pratiyoginīti śeṣaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-gauṇatve'pi nañ‌samāse "etattadoḥ sulopo'koranañ‌samāse hali" (pāo sūo 3-1-132) iti jñāpakāt sarvanāmasaṃjñānānupapannā| `asaḥ śivaḥ' ityatra sulopavāraṇāya `anañsamāse'iti hi viśeṣaṇam| naca tatra tacchabdasya sarvanāmatā'sti, gauṇatvāt| `akoḥ' ityakac‌sahitavyāvṛttyā sarvanāmnoreva tatra grahaṇalābhāt| tathāca `anañ‌samāse' iti jñāpakaṃ suvacam| "anekamanyapadārthe" ityādāvekavacanam, viśeṣyānurodhāt| "subāmantrite parāṅgavat svare" (pāo sūo 2-1-2) ityato'nuvartamānaṃ subgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣyamekavacanāntameva| kiñcānekaśabdād dvivacanopādāne bahūnāṃ, bahuvacanopādāne dvayorbahuvrīhirna siddhayedityubhayasaṃgrahāyaikavacanam, jātyabhiprāyam, autsargikaṃ vā| "sevyate'nekayā" ityatrāpi `yoṣayā' iti viśeṣyānurodhāt, pratyekaṃ sevanānvayabodhanāya caikavacanam, natūttarapadārthaprādhānyaprayuktam| ata eva "patantyaneke jaladherivormayaḥ" ityādikamapi sūpapādam| `atbaṃ bhabasi' ityādau yuṣmadasmadostadbhinne lakṣaṇā| nañ‌ dyotakaḥ| tathāca bhinnena yuṣmadarthena tiṅaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt puruṣavyavasthā| `tvadbhinnāśrayikā bhavanakriyā iti śābdabodhaḥ| evam ` na tvaṃ pacasi' ityatra tvadabhinnāśrayakapākānukūlabhāvanā'bhāvaḥ| `ghaṭo nāsti' ityatra ghaṭābhinnāśrayakāstitvābhāva iti rītyā bodhaḥ| asamastanañaḥ kriyāyāmevānvayāt| sa cābhāvo'tyantābhāvatvānyonyābhāvatvādirūpeṇa śakyaḥ, tattadrūpeṇa bodhādityādyanyatra vistaraḥ || 41 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre nañarthanirṇayaḥ || 7 || <8> <8-0> || atha nipātārthanirṇayaḥ || <8-1> prādīnāṃ dyotakatvaṃ cādīnāṃ vācakatvamiti naiyāyikamatanirākaraṇam prādayo dyotakāḥ, cādayo vācakāḥ, iti naiyāyikamatamayuktam, baiṣamye bījābhāvāditi dhvanayannipātānāṃ dyotakatbaṃ bhāvaḥ-`īśvaramanubhavati' ityādāvanubhavādiḥ pratīyamāno na dhātvarthaḥ, `bhavati' ityatrāpyāpatteḥ| nopasargārthaḥ, tathā satyaprakṛtyarthatayā tatrākhyātārthānanvayāpatteḥ, pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvisvārthabodhakatvavyutpatteḥ, `anugacchati' ityādau anubhavādipratyayāpatteśca| na viśiṣṭārthaḥ, gauravāt| tathāca dhātoreva vidyamānatvādivācakasyāstu takṣaṇā, upasargastātparyyagrāhaka tātparyyagrāhakatvalābhāditi bhāvaḥ| `dṛśyate' ityatra `karmaṇi' iti śeṣaḥ || 4 || <8-2> cādiṣvapi dyotakataiveti siddhāntapratipādanam taccādiṣvapi tulyamityāha-- tathānyatra nipāte'pi lakāraḥ karmavācakaḥ| viśeṣaṇadyayogo'pi prādivaccādike samaḥ || 43 || anyatra-`sākṣātkriyate,' `alaṅ‌kriyate,' ūrīkriyate śivaḥ,' ityādau| atrāpi dhātostattadarthe karmaṇi lakārasiddhayarthaṃ kartṛviśiṣṭabhāvanāyāṃ lakṣaṇā'stu tātparyyagrāhakatvamātraṃ tiṅādeḥ syādityaruceḥ pakṣāntaramāha- nipātānāṃ vācakatvamanvayavyatirekayoḥ| yuktaṃ vā natu tad‌yuktaṃ pareṣāṃ matameva naḥ || 47 || evañca `dhātvarthaprātipadikārthayorbhedenānvayabodho na vyutpannaḥ' iti nipātātiriktaviṣayaḥ| samānādhikaraṇaprātipadikārthayorabhedānvaya ityapi tathetyagatyā kalpanīyamiti bhāvaḥ| natviti| naiyāyikoktaṃ prādi-cād‌yorvaiṣamyamityarthaḥ| <8-2-6>nipāteṣu kecit dyotakāḥ kecit vācakāḥ iti pakṣasya nirākaraṇam yattu-sarveṣāṃ nipātānāṃ vācakatve'rthavatsūtreṇaiva teṣāṃ prātipadikatvasambhavāt "nipātasyānarthakasya" iti vidhivaiyarthyam| sarveṣāṃ d‌yotakatve "cānarthakasya" iti vyartham| tathāca kecid d‌yotakāḥ kecidvācakā ityabhyupeyamiti, tanna, evaṃ hi `cādayo d‌yotakā prādayo vācakāḥ' iti vaiparītyāvāraṇāt| sarvathānarthakānāṃ pādapūraṇamātrārthamupāttānāṃ saṃgrahāya vārttikārambhasya kaiyaṭādau spaṣṭatvāt, tasya pratyākhyātatvācca| <8-2-7>vācakatvapakṣe lāghavamiti samuccayādhikaraṇoktinirāsaḥ `pareṣām' iti bahuvacanaṃ mīmāṃsakasaṃgrahāya| kevalavṛkṣaśabdāt samuccayābodhāccakāraśravaṇe tad‌bodhāccakāra eva tadvācakaḥ, na dyotakaḥ| kiñca dyotakatve padāntarāṇāṃ tatra śaktiḥ kalpyā, cakārāderdyotakatvaśaktiśca kalpyeti gauravaṃ syāditi hi samuccayādhikaraṇe sthitam, tadapi na yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| tathāhi-anvayavyatirekau tātparyyagrāhakatvenāpyupayuktau| ghaṭādipadānāmeva samuccite lakṣaṇā, tātparyyagrāhakaḥ prakāraṇādivaccādiriti svīkārānna śaktidvayakalpanā'pi| asmākaṃ lakṣaṇāgrahadaśāyāṃ bodhāttattatkāryyakāraṇabhāva āvaśyakaḥ| evaṃ śaktigrahasyāpīti pakṣadvaye'pi kalpyāntarābhāvena gauravābhāvādubhayamapi yuktamityabhimatam| ata eva| "sa vācako viśeṣāṇāṃ sambhavād dyotako'pi vā"| iti vākyapadīyaṃ saṅgacchate| darśanāntararītyā vācakatvameva dyotakatvameveti niyamastu na yukta iti dhvanayannāha-`matameva naḥ' iti || 47 || <8-2-8>nipātatvapariṣkāraḥ paryyavasitamupasaṃharannāha- nipātatvaṃ pareṣāṃ yattadasmākamiti sthitiḥ| vyāpakatvācchaktatāyāstvavacchedakamiṣyate || 48 || pareṣāṃ yannipātatvam-asattvārthakatve sati cādigaṇapaṭhitatvam, śaktisambandhena nipātapadavattvañca jātirvā, upādhirvā tadevāsmākamapi| parantu sāmānyadharmme pramāṇānāṃ pakṣapātācchaktatā, dyotakatā vā tadavacchedenaiva kal‌pyeti naiyāyikoktaprādicādyorvaiṣamyamayuktamityarthaḥ| vyāpakatvāt-sāmānyatvāt| śaktatāyā ityupalakṣaṇam-dyotakatāyā vetyapi draṣṭavyam || 48 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre nipātānāṃ dyotakatvādinirṇayaḥ || 8 || <9> <9-0> || atha tvādibhāvapratyayārthanirṇayaḥ || <9-1> vaiyākaraṇamatena bhāvapratyayārthaḥ bhāvapratyayārthamāha- kṛttaddhitasamāsebhyo matabhedanibandhanam| tvatalorarthakathanaṃ ṭīkāyāṃ hariṇā kṛtam || 49 || "kṛttaddhitasamāsebhyaḥ sambandhābhidhānaṃ bhāvapratyayenā'nyatra rūḍhyabhinnarūpāvyabhicaritasambandhebhyaḥ" iti vārttikavacanamiti mīmāṃsakādīnāṃ bhramamapākurvannāha-ṭīkāyāmiti| bhartṛhariṇā mahābhāṣyaṭīkāyāmityarthaḥ| tvataloriti-bhāvapratyayamātropalakṣaṇam| ayamarthaḥ-samāsādau śaktiḥ kalpyamānā rājādisambandhaviśiṣṭe kalpyate ityuktam| tathāca taduttarabhāvapratyayaḥ sambandhaṃ vadatītyarthaḥ| etadapi `bhedaḥ' saṃsargaḥ, ubhayaṃ vetyukteṣu bhedapakṣe na sambhavatītyata āha-matabhedeti-pakṣabhedetyarthaḥ| evañca rājapuruṣatvam, aupagavatvam, paktṛtvamityādau svasvāmibhāvasambandhaḥ, upagvapatyasambandhaḥ, (apatyāpatyavatsambandhaḥ) kriyākārakabhāvasambandhaḥ, ityanvayabodhaḥ| aupagavādāvavyabhicaritasambandhe tu arthāntaravṛttistaddhita udāhāryyaḥ| `dāmodaratvam' kṛṣṇasarpatvam' ityādau jātiviśeṣabodhādāha-anyatreti-rūḍherabhinnarūpādavyabhicaritasambandhebhyaścānyatretyarthaḥ| rūḍhiruktā| dvitīyaṃ yathā - śuklatvam| atra "tadasyāstyasmin" (pāo sūo 5-2-14) iti matupaḥ "guṇavacanebhyo matupo lugiṣṭaḥ" (pāo vāo) iti luptatvāt taddhitāntatve'pi `ghaṭaḥ śuklaḥ' ityabhedapratyayād guṇasyaiva prakāratvena bhānaṃ jāyate| tṛtīyam-sato bhāvaḥ satteti| atra jātāveva pratyaya iti dik || 49 || <9-2> mīmāṃsakamatakhaṇḍanam daṇḍītyādau prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭadravyamātravācakatā taddhitasyeti vadantaṃ mīmāṃsakammanyaṃ pratyāha- atrārddhajaratīyaṃ syād darśanāntaragāminām| siddhānte tu sthitaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ tvādiṣu tacchṛṇu || 50 || atra-bhāvapratyayaviṣaye| tathāhi-dāmodaratvam, ghaṭatvamityādau bhāvapratyayasya sambandhānabhidhāyakatvena mīmāṃsakānāṃ daṇḍitvamityādiṣvapi tadabhidhānaṃ na syāt| prakṛtijanyabodhe prakāraḥ prakṛtyarthasamaveto hi taduttarabhāvapratyayenābhidhiyate| anyathā ghaṭatvamityatra dravyatvādeḥ, daṇḍitvamityādau daṇḍādeśca taduttarabhāvapratyayavācyatāpatteḥ| naca tanmate daṇḍītyādibodhe sambandhaḥ prakāraḥ| yattu-yadā svasamaveto'tra vācyo nāsti guṇo'paraḥ| tadā gatyantarābhāvāt sambandho vācya āśritaḥ || iti || tanna, inādeḥ sambandhivācakatvenopapattau gatyabhāvābhāvāt| prapañcitañcaitadādāveva vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇe| nanu tavāpīdaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ kathamityata āha-siddhānte tviti| `jāyante' iti vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣaṇe'nvitam| siddhānte prakṛtijanyabodhe prakāre tvādayo jāyanta ityarthaḥ| prakṛtijanyabodhe prakāra ityatra pakṣadvayaṃ sthitamiti yojanā || 50 || <9-3> prakṛtijanyabodhe prakāra ityatra pakṣadvayam tau pakṣāvāha- prayogopādhimāśritya prakṛtyarthaprakāratām| dharmmamātraṃ vācyamiti yadvā śabdaparā amī || 51 || jāyante tajjanyabodhaprakāre bhāvasaṃjñite| prayoge upādhirnimittaṃ prakṛtyarthaprakāratām-prakāratayā bhāsamānaṃ dharmmaṃ vācyatayā āśritya tvādayo jāyante| prakṛtijanyabodhe prakārastvādyartha iti yāvāt| nanu `ghaṭatvam' ityatra prakāratvāt taduttarabhāvapratyayena ghaṭatvatvasyāpi vācyatā syādityatreṣṭāpattimāha-dharmamātramiti, natvatra laghuguruvicāra ityabhiprāyaḥ| tattad‌vyaktiviśiṣṭabrahmasattāyā eva ghaṭatva-ghaṭatvatvādirūpatvāt| sambandhibhedāt sattaiva bhidyamānā gavādiṣu| jātirityucyate tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyāvasthitāḥ|| tāṃ prātipadikārthañca dhātvarthañca pracakṣate| sā nityā sā mahānātmā tāmāhustvatalādayaḥ|| iti vākyapadīyāt| uktañca "tasya bhāvastvatalau" (pāo sūo 5-1-119) iti sūtre vārttikakāraiḥ-"yasya guṇasya bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau" iti| yasya guṇasya-viśeṣaṇatayā bhāsamānasya, bhāvāt-āśrayatvāt, dravye-viśeṣye, śabdaniveśaḥ-śabdapravṛttiḥ, tasmin vācye tvatalāvityarthaḥ| tathāca rūpādiśabdebhyo jātau, śuklāṇudīrghamahadādibhyo guṇe, pācakādiśabdebhyaḥ kriyāyām, ghaṭādiśabdebhyojātau pratyayaḥ, rūpādiśabdānāṃ jātiprakārakabodhajanakatvāt| pācakādiśabdānāṃ kriyāprakārakabodhajanakatve tasyāṃ pratyayaḥ| `saṃsargaprakārakabodhajanakatvam' iti mate ca saṃsarga iti vyavasthā sūpapādeti bhāvaḥ| tatra jātivācakānāṃ vyaktaya eva śakyatā'vacchedikāḥ| tathāca `ghaṭatvam' ityatra `ghaṭavṛttirasādhāraṇo dharmmaḥ' iti bodha ityādi draṣṭavyam| pakṣāntaramāha-yadveti-"yadvā sarve bhāvāḥ svenārthena bhavanti, sa teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ" iti vārttikokteḥ| yadvāśabdastatsūcanaprayojanako'pi| bhavanti-vācakatvena pravarttante iti bhāvāḥ-śabdāḥ| svena-rūpeṇa-arthena bhavanti-pravarttante| ataḥ sa teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ-pravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-arthavacchabdo'pi dravye prakāraḥ| hariharanalekṣavākuyudhiṣṭhiravasiṣṭhādiśabdebhyastattadvācyaḥ kaścidāsīditi śabdaprakārakabodhasya sarvasiddhatvāt, anyathā vanauṣadhivargādernāgarikān pratyabodhakatvāpatteśca| evamevāprasiddhārthakapadeṣvanubhavaḥ sarvasiddhaḥ, natu ghaṭādipadeṣviva tattajjātyādibhedena (rūpeṇa)| tathācobhayamavacchedakam| yasya tathāśaktigrahastasya jātyādirūpeṇaivopasthitiḥ| padāprakārakaḥ śaktigrahastu viśiṣya nāpekṣitaḥ| kintu `idaṃ padaṃ kvacicchaktam, sādhupadatvāt ityādirūpa evāpekṣyate iti viśiṣyāgṛhītaśaktikebhyastathaiva bodhaḥ| tathāca `śabdo'pi tvapratyayārthaḥ' iti prapañcitaṃ bhūṣaṇe || 51 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre tvādibhāvapratyayārthanirṇayaḥ || 9 || <10> || atha devatāpratyayārthanirṇayaḥ || <10-1> devatāviśiṣṭaṃ deyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ "sāsya devatā" (pāo sūo 4-2-4) ityatra devatāviśiṣṭaṃ deyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ| `aindrī' `vaiśvadevī' ityādau indrāderdevatātvopasthāpakāntarābhāvāt, tena rūpeṇopasthitaye śaktikalpanā''vaśyakatvāt| ata eva-- āmikṣāṃ devatāyuktāṃ vadatyevaiṣa taddhitaḥ| āmikṣāpadasānnidhyāttasyaiva viṣayārpaṇam || iti || kevalāddevatāvācī taddhito'gneḥ samuccaran| nānyayukto'gnidaivatyaṃ pratipādayitaṃ kṣamaḥ || iti ca mīmāṃsakairapyuktamityāśayenāha- pratyayārthasyaikadeśe prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam || 52 || abhedaścātra saṃsarga āgneyādāviyaṃ sthitiḥ| devatāyāṃ pradeye ca khaṇḍaśaḥ śaktirastu vā || 53 || ekadeśe-devatārūpe| tacca viśeṣaṇamabhedenetyāha-abhedaśceti| nanu devatāyāḥ pratyayārthokadeśatvānna prakṛtyarthasya tatrābhedenāpyanvaya ityāśayenāha-devatāyāmiti-tathāca padārthaikadeśataiva nāstīti bhāvaḥ || 53 || devatāviśiṣṭaṃ deyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ <10-2> deye śaktiḥ devatāyāṃ lakṣaṇā ityādipakṣāḥ nanvagnyādidevasya prakṛtyaiva lābhānna tatra śaktiḥ kalpyā| naca devatātvena rūpeṇopasthitaye sā kalpyate| prakṛterlakṣaṇayaiva tathopasthitisambhavāt| upasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvanaye `prajayati' ityatra prakṛṣṭajayapratyayavadityabhipretyāha- pradeya eva vā śaktiḥ prakṛtervāstu lakṣaṇā| devatāyāṃ nirūḍheti sarve pakṣā amī sthitāḥ || 54 || naca `aindraṃ dadhi' ityādau dravyasya padāntarāllābhāt kutaḥ punaḥ pratyayasya tatra śaktiḥ kalpyata iti vācyam, padāntarāśravaṇo'pi tatpratīteḥ, `aindraṃ dadhi' iti sāmānādhikāraṇyācca| anyathā''khyātasyāpi karttṛkarmavācitvaṃ na syāt| mīmāṃsakānāṃ punaḥ pratyayasya devatātvamevārtho'stu| dravyaṃ padāntarāllabhyata eveti ākhyātasya karttṛvadvācyatvaṃ mā'stviti kuto na śakyate vaktumiti dik| devatāyāṃ devatātvena rūpeṇa nirūḍheti-anupapattijñānāpūrvakatvam, anādiprayogāvacchinnatvaṃ vā tattvamiti bhāvaḥ || 54 || <10-3>anyataddhitārthanirūpaṇam anayaiva rītyā'nyatrāpyavadheyamityāha- krīḍāyāṃ ṇastadasyāstītyādāveṣaiva dik smṛtā| vastuto vṛttireveti nātrātīva prayatyate || 55 || "tadasyāṃ praharaṇamiti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ" (pāo sūo 4-2-57) ityatra praharaṇaviśiṣṭā krīḍā, praharaṇakrīḍe, krīḍāmātraṃ bā'rthaḥ| ādinā "so'sya nivāsaḥ" (pāo sūo 4-3-89) "sā'smin paurṇamāsīti" (pā sū 4-2-21) "tadasyāstyarimanniti matup" (pāo sūo 5-2-14) ityādikaṃ saṃgṛhyate| vṛttimātre'tiriktaśakteḥ, "samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ" (pāo sūo 2-1-1) iti sūtrāllābhādukto vicāraḥ śāstrāntarīyaiḥ saha tadrītyaivoktaḥ| āropitaprakṛtipratyayārthamādāya vā| vastuto viśaṣṭaśaktayaivārthopasthitirityāha-vastuta iti || 55 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre devatāpratyayārthanirṇayaḥ || 10 || <11> <11-0> || athābhedaikatvasaṅ‌khyānirṇayaḥ || <11-0>abhedaikatvasaṅkhyā vṛttau bhāsate iti siddhāntapratipādanam vṛttiprasaṅgāt tatrābhedaikatvasaṅkhayā pratīyate iti siddhāntaṃ dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati-- abhedaikatvasaṅkhayāyā vṛttau bhānamiti sthitiḥ| kapiñjalālambhavākye tritvaṃ nyāyād yathocyate || 56 || <11-1>tatra saṅkhyāviśeṣāṇāmavibhāgenāvasthānamiti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ saṅkhayāviśeṣāṇāmavibhāgena sattvam-abhedaikatvasaṅkhayā| uktañca vākyapadīye- yathauṣadhirasāḥ sarve madhunyāhitaśaktayaḥ| avibhāgena varttante saṅkhayāṃ tāṃ tādṛśīṃ viduḥ || iti || <11-2> parityaktaviśeṣaṃ saṅkhyāsāmānyamiti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ parityaktaviśeṣaṃ vā saṅkhayāsāmānyaṃ tat| uktañca-- bhedānāṃ vā parityāgāt saṅkhayātmā sa tathāvidhaḥ| vyāpārājjatibhāgasya bhedāpohe (ho) na varttate|| agṛhītaviśeṣeṇa yathā rūpeṇa rūpavān| prakhyāyate na śuklādirbhedāpohastu gamyate || iti || asyā vṛttau-samāsādau bhānaṃ nyāyasiddhamiti śeṣaḥ| iti matasthitirvaiyākaraṇānām| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-`rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādau rājñaḥ, rājñoḥ, rājñāṃ vā'yaṃ puruṣa iti jijñāsā jāyate| viśeṣajijñāsā ca sāmānyajñānapūrviketi sāmānyarūpeṇa tatpratītiḥ śabdādāvaśyakī| atastasyāṃ śaktiriti| tasyā ekatvatvena pratītau nyāyamāha-kapiñjaleti-bahutvagaṇanāyāṃ tritvasyaiva prathamopasthitatvāt tadrūpeṇaiva bhānavad ekatvasya sarvataḥ prathamopasthitatvamastīti bhāvaḥ| <11-3>saṅkhyāpratītireva neti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ vastutastu jijñāsaiva nānubhavasiddhā| tathātve vā jñānecchayoḥ samānaprakārakatvenaiva hetuhetumadbhāvāttadrūpeṇaiva vācyatā syāditi dhyeyam || 56 || <11-3>saṅkhyāpratītireva neti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre abhedaikatvasaṅkhayānirūpaṇam || 11 || <12> <12-0> atha saṅ‌khyāvivakṣānirṇayaḥ <12-1> lakṣyānurodhenaiva uddeśyavidheyayoḥ saṅkhyāvivakṣāvivakṣe saṅkhayāprasaṅgāduddeśyavidheyayoḥ saṅkhyāvivakṣā'vivakṣe nirūpayati-- lakṣyānurodhāt saṅkhyāyāstantrātantre mate yataḥ| paśvekatvādihetūnāmāśrayaṇamanākaram || 57 || "grahaṃ sammārṣṭi" ityatroddeśyagrahagatamekatvamavivakṣitamitivannāsmākamuddeśyaviśeṣaṇāvivakṣāniyamaḥ, `dhātoḥ' ityekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt, utpadyeta samastebhyo dhātubhyaḥ pratyayo yadi| tadā sarvairviśiṣyeta dvandvotpannasubarthavat || iti || śabdāntarādhikaraṇe bhaṭṭapādairabhidhānācca, "ārddhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ" (pāo sūo 7-2-35) ityatrānuvādyārddhadhātukaviśeṣaṇasya valāditvasya vivakṣitatvācca| evam-`paśunā yajeta' itivad vidheyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitamityapi niyamo na, "radābhyāṃniṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ" (8-2-42) ityatra nakāradvayavidhānānāpatteḥ| tathāca `bhinnaḥ' ityatra nakāradvayalābho na syāt| "ād guṇaḥ" (6-1-87) ityādāvekatvavivakṣayaivopapattau "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" (6-1-84) ityekagrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatteśceti bhāvaḥ| śabdārthastu-saṅkhyāyā lakṣyānurodhāttantrā'tantre yato mate, ataḥ paśvekatvādhikaraṇoktahetūnāmāśrayaṇaṃ nāsmatsiddhāntasiddhamiti| ādinā grahaikatvasaṃgrahaḥ || 57 || <12-2>vidheye saṅkhyāyāḥ vivakṣā anyatrāvivakṣā nanu vidheyaviśeṣaṇavivakṣā āvaśyakī, anyathā `suddhayupāsyaḥ' ityādāvanantayakārādyāpatteḥ| `bhinnaḥ' ityatra nakāradvayavadanyeṣāmapyāpatteḥ| `ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ' ityatraikagrahaṇañca sthānibhedādādeśabhedavāraṇāyetyabhipretyāha-- vidheye bhedakaṃ tantramanyato niyamo nahi| grahaikatvādihetūnāmāśrayaṇamanākaram || 58 || bhedakam-viśeṣaṇam| tantram-bivakṣitam| vidheyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitamityastu, tathāpyanyataḥ- anuvādyasya niyamo nahi| kvacit tantram, kvacinnetyarthaḥ| grahaikatvādau yo heturvā?yabhedādistasyātrāśrayaṇamanākaram| ekatvaviśiṣṭaṃ dhātum, valāditvaviśiṣṭamārddhadhātukañcoddiśya pratyayeḍāgamādervidhisambhavāditi bhāvaḥ || 58 || <12-3>radābhyāmityatra nakāradvayalābhopapādanam nanvevam `bhinnaḥ' ityatra nakāradvayalābho na syādityata āha- radābhyāṃ vākyabhedena nakāradvayalābhataḥ| kṣatirnaivāsti tantratve vidheye bhedakasya tu || 59 || cakārasūcitam-niṣṭhātasya naḥ, pūrvasya dakārasya ca na iti vākyabhedamādāya nakāradvayalābha ityarthaḥ || 59 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre saṅkhyāvivakṣānirṇayaḥ || 12 || <13> <13.0> || atha ktvādyarthanirṇayaḥ || <13.1>avyayakṛtāṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ bhāva evārthaḥ ktavāpratyayāderarthaṃ nirūpayati- avyayakṛta ityukteḥ prakṛtyarthe tumādayaḥ| samānakartṛkatbādi dyotyameṣāmiti sthitiḥ || 60 || tumādayaḥ-tumunnādayaḥ| prakṛtyarthe-bhāve| ādinā-ktavādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ| bhāve ityatra mānamāha-avyayakṛta iti-avyayakṛto bhāve, iti vārttikādityarthaḥ| nanu `samānakarttṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' ityādisūtrāṇāṃ kā gatistatrāha-samānakartṛkatvādīti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-`bhoktuṃ pacati' `bhuktavā vrajati' ityādāvekavākyatā sarvasiddhā bhojanapākakriyayorviśeṣyarviśeṣaṇabhāvamantareṇānupapannā| anyathā `bhuṅkte' `vrajati' ityādāvapyekavākyatā''patteḥ| tathāca tayorviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvanirūpakaḥ saṃsargaḥ, janyatvam, sāmānādhikaraṇyam, pūrvottarabhāvaḥ, vyāpyatvañcetyādiranekavidhaḥ| tathāca-`bhoktuṃ pacati' `bhuktvā tṛptaḥ' ityādau bhojanajanikā pākakriyā, bhojanajanyā tṛptiriti bodhaḥ| ata eva jalapānānantaraṃ yasya tṛptau sattve'pi `pītvā tṛptaḥ' iti na prayogaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyasyāpi saṃsargatvenārthātsamānakartṛkatvamapi labdham| `bhuktavā vrajati' ityādau pūrvottarabhāvaḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇyañca saṃsarga iti bhojanasamānādhikaraṇā taduttarakālikī vrajanakriyeti bodhaḥ| `adhītya tiṣṭhati' mukhaṃ vyādāya svapiti' ityādāvadhyayanavyādānayorabhāvakāle'prayogāt yadā yadā'sya sthitiḥ, svāpaśca-tadā tadā'dhyayanam, mukhavyādānañceti kālaviśeṣāvacchinnavyāpyatvabodhāt| vyāpyatvam, sāmānādhikaraṇyañca saṃsargaḥ| <13.2>samānakartṛkatvādīnāmavācyatvam evañcānyalabhyatvānna sūtrātteṣāṃ vācyatvalābhaḥ iti yuktam-`avyayakṛto bhāve' iti| evañca prakṛtyarthakriyayoḥ saṃsarge tātparyyagrāhakatvarūpaṃ d‌yotakatvaṃ ktavādīnām‌| ata eva samānakartṛkayoḥ' iti sūtre `svaśabdenopāttatvānna' iti bhāṣyapratīkamādāya `--paurvāparyyakāle dyotye ktvādirvidhīyate, natu viṣaye iti bhāva iti' kaiyaṭaḥ| <13.2.1>samānakartṛkatvādīnāṃ vācyatvamāvaśyakamiti śaṅkā yattu-`samānakartṛkayoḥ' iti sūtrātsamānakartṛkatvaṃ ktavāvācyam, anyathaudanaṃ paktvā'haṃ bhokṣaye' ityatra mayeti tṛtīyāprasaṅgaśca| nacākhyātena karturabhidhānānna seti vācyam, bhojanakriyākartturabhidhānepi pākakriyākartustadabhāvāt| anabhihite bhavati iti paryudāsāśrayaṇāt| ata eva`prāsāde āste' ityatra prasādanakriyādhikaraṇasyābhidhāne'pyāstikriyādhikaraṇasyānabhidhānātsaptamīti bhāṣye spaṣṭam| tasmāt ktvāpratyayasya kartṛvācitvamāvaśyakamiti, <13.2.2>samānakartṛkatvādīnāṃ vācyatvamāvaśyakamiti śaṅkāyāḥ nirāsaḥ tanna, sūtrāttasya vācyatvālābhāt, `samānakartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrvakāle ktvā' ityeva tadarthāt| anyathā `samānakarttari' ityeva sūtranyāsaḥ syāt| tṛtīyāpādanantu--ākhyātārthakriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyāḥ karturabhidhānātpradhānānurodhena guṇe kāryapravṛtterna sambhavati| uktañca vākyapadīye-- pradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak| śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanuruddhyate| pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate| yadā guṇe tadā tadvadanuktā'pi pratīyate | iti | kiñcānyathā karmaṇo'pi ktvārthatā''pattiḥ, `paktvaudano mayā bhujyate' ityatra dvitīyāyāḥ prakārāntareṇāvāraṇādityāstāṃ vistaraḥ || 60 || iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre ktvādyarthanirṇayaḥ || 12 || <14> <14.0> || atha sphoṭanirūpaṇam || <14.1>vākyasphoṭasyaiva mukhyattvamiti siddhāntaḥ siddhāntaniṣkarṣamāha- vākyasphoṭo'tiniṣkarṣe tiṣṭhatīti matasthitiḥ| yadyapi varṇasphoṭaḥ, padasphoṭaḥ, vākyasphoṭaḥ, akhaṇḍapadavākyasphoṭau, varṇapadavākyabhedena trayo jātisphoṭā ityaṣṭau pakṣāḥ siddhāntasiddhā iti vākyagrahaṇamanarthakam, durarthakañca, tathā'pi vākyasphoṭātiriktānāmanyeṣāmapyavāstavatvabodhanāya tadupādānam| etadeva dhvanayati-atiniṣkarṣa iti- iti matasthitirvaiyākaraṇānām-mahābhāṣyakārādīnām| <14.2> varṇasphoṭanirūpaṇam tatra krameṇa sarvāṃstān nirūpayan varṇasphoṭaṃ prathamamāha-sāduśabda iti-sādhuśabdāntargatā vācakā naveti vipratipattiḥ| sādhuśabdāntargatā vācakāḥ natu taiḥ smṛtāḥ || 61 || 2 vidhikoṭiranyeṣām, neti vaiyākaraṇānām| sādhuśabde `pacati' `rāmaḥ' ityādiprayujyamāne'ntargatāstibvisargādaya eva bodhakāḥ-vācakāḥ, tasyaiva śaktatvasya prāgvyavasthāpitatvāt| natutaiḥ smṛtāḥ lādayaḥ, svādayaścetyarthaḥ | 61 | <14.2.1>prayogāntargatānāṃ na vācakatvamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ ye tu prayogāntargatāstibvisargādayo na vācakāḥ, teṣāṃ bahutvena śaktayānantyāpatteḥ, `edhāñcakre' `brahma' ityādāvādeśalugāderabhāvarūpasya bodhakatvāsambhavācca| kintu taiḥ smṛtā lakārāḥ svādayaśca vācakāḥ, latvasya jātirūpatayā śaktatā'vacchedakatvaucityāt, avyabhicārācca| ādeśānāṃ bhinnatayā parasparavyabhicaritatvāt| laḥ karmaṇītyādyanuśāsanānuguṇyācca| nahyādeśeṣvarthavattābodhakamanuśāsanamupalabhāmahe ityāhuḥ| <14.2.2>prayogāntargatānāṃ vācakatvasamarthanam tān svasādhakayuktibhirnirācaṣṭe- vyavasthitervyavahṛtestaddhetunyāyatastathā| kiñcā'khyātena śatrādyairlaḍeva smāryate yadi || 62 || kathaṃ karturavācyatvavācyatve tadvibhāvaya| vyavasthānurodhāt prayogāntargatā eva vācakāḥ, natu taiḥ smṛtā ityarthaḥ| tathāhi-pacatītyādau lakāramaviduṣo bodhānna tasya vācakatvam| naca teṣāṃ tiṅ‌kṣu śaktibhramād bodhaḥ, tasya bhramatve mānābhāvāt, ādeśināmapi tattad‌vaiyākaraṇaiḥ svecchayā bhinnānāmabhyupagamāt, kaḥ śaktaḥ ko neti vyavasthānāpatteśca| sarveṣāṃ śaktatve gauravam, vyabhicāraścāstyeva| ādeśānāṃ prayogāntargatatayā niyatatvād yuktaṃ teṣāṃ śaktatvam| tathācādeśismaraṇakalpanā neti lāghavam| sādhakāntaramāha-vyavahṛteriti || vyavahārastāvacchaktigrāhakeṣu mukhyaḥ| sa ca śrūyamāṇatiṅādiṣveveti te eva vācakā ityarthaḥ| kiñca taddhetunyāyata iti-- lakārasya bodhakatve `bhū l' ityato'pi bodhāpattiḥ syāt| tādṛśabodhe bhavatīti samabhivyāhāro'pi kāraṇamiti cet, tarhyāvaśayakatvādastu tādṛśasamabhivyāhārasyaiva vācakatvaśaktiḥ| anyathā lakārasya vācakatvam, samabhivyāhārasya kāraṇatvañcetyubhayaṃ kalpyamiti gauravaṃ syāt| tathāca ?tādṛśasamabhivyāhṛtā varṇāvetyatra vinigamanāvirahāt prayogāntargatāvarṇā vācakā iti siddhayatīti bhāvaḥ| apica lakārasyaiva vācakatve kṛttiṅoḥ kartṛbhāvanāvācakatvavyavasthā tvatsiddhāntasiddhā na syādityāha-kiñceti-ādeśānāṃ vācakatve ca tiṅ‌tvena bhāvanāyām, śānacādinā karttari śaktirityupapadyate vibhāga iti bhāvaḥ| naca śānajādau kṛtirlakārārthaḥ, āśrayaḥ śānajartha ityastu, "karttari kṛt" ityanuśāsanāditi śaṅkayam, sthānyarthena nirākāṅ‌kṣatayā śānajādau kartarītyasyāpravṛtteḥ| anyathā ghañādāvapi pravartteta || 62 || <14.2.3>sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt śānacaḥ kartrarthakatvam iti śaṅkānirāsaḥ `devadattaḥ pacamānaḥ' ityādisāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhācchānacaḥ kartā vācyaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha- tarabādyantatiṅ‌kṣvasti nāmatā kṛtsviva sphuṭā || 63 || nāmārthayorabhedo'pi tasmāttulyo'vadhāryyatām| `pacatitarāṃ maitraḥ' `pacatikalpaṃ maitraḥ' ityādiṣu nāmārthatvābhedānvayayoḥ sambhava eveti kartṛvācakatā syāditi bhāvaḥ| naca pacatikalpamityatra sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt karttari lakṣaṇā, `pacamānaḥ' ityatrāpyāpatteriti| laḥ karmaṇītyanuśāsanañca lāghavāt kalpite lakāre kartrādivācitvaṃ kalpitamādāyetyuktam || 63 || iti varṇasphoṭanirūpaṇam|| <14.3>padasphoṭanirūpaṇam <14.3>sakhaṇḍapadasphoṭanirūpaṇam(śaktaṃ padamiti pāribhāṣikapadasphoṭanirūpaṇam) athādeśā vācakāścet padasphoṭastataḥ sphuṭaḥ || 64 || evamādeśānāṃ vācakatve siddhe padasphoṭo'pi siddha evetyāha-athetyādi| ādeśāḥ-tibvisargādayaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāṃ vācakatve siddhe tādṛśavarṇasamabhivyāhārarūpapadasya vācakatā siddhyati, prativarṇamarthasmaraṇasyānubhavaviruddhatvāt, pratyekaṃ varṇānāmarthavattve prātipadikatvā'pattau "na lopaḥ prātipadikāntasya" ityādibhiḥ `dhanam' `vanam' ityādau nalopādyāpatteśca| etacca caramavarṇe eva vācakatvaśaktiḥ, śaktervyāsajyavṛttitve mānābhāvāt| pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavajanyasaṃskārāścarameṇārthadhījanane sahakāriṇa iti na tanmātroccāraṇādarthadhīriti varṇāsphoṭavādināṃ matāntarasya dūṣaṇāyoktam| rāmo'stīti vaktavye rām ityanantaraṃ ghaṭikottaramokāroccāraṇe'rthabodhāpattyā tādṛśānupūrvyā eva śaktatā'vacchedakatvaicityāditi dik || 64 || <14.4>akhaṇḍapadasphoṭanirūpaṇam(suptiṅantaṃ padamiti pāribhāṣikapadasphoṭanirūpaṇam) `suptiṅantaṃ padam' iti pāribhāṣikapadasya vācakatvasvīkarttṝṇāṃ matamāha- ghaṭenetyādiṣu nahi prakṛtyādibhidā sthitā| vasnasādāvivehāpi sampramoho hi dṛśyate || 65 || ghaṭenetyādau `ghaṭe' iti prakṛtiḥ, `na' iti pratyayaḥ, `ghaṭ' iti prakṛtiḥ, `ena' pratyaya iti vibhāgasya, `sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ' iti svīkāre viśiṣya prakṛtipratyayayorjñānāsambhavānna vācakatvamityarthaḥ| vaiyākaraṇaurvibhāgaḥ sujñeya ityato dṛṣṭāntavyājenāha-vasnasādāviti-`bahuvacanasya vasnasau' iti samudāyasyā''deśavidhānānnātra tadvibhāgaḥ sambhavatītyarthaḥ || 65 || <14.5>sakhaṇḍavākyasphoṭanirūpaṇam(suptiṅantacayarūpavākyasphoṭanirūpaṇam) suptiṅantacayarūpavākyasyāpi tadāha-- hare'vetyādi dṛṣṭ‌vā ca vākyasphoṭaṃ viniścinu| arthe viśiṣyasambandhāgrahaṇaṃ cet samaṃ pade || 66 || lakṣaṇādadhunā cettatpade'rthe'pyastu tat tathā| `hare'va' viṣṇo'va ityādau padayoḥ "eṅaḥ padāntādati" ityekādeśe sati na tadvibhāgaḥ sujñānaḥ| tathāca pratyekaṃ padājñāne'pi samudāyaśaktijñānācchābdabodhāt samudāye'pyāvaśiyakī śaktiḥ| evañca prakṛtipratyayeṣu viśiṣyājñāyamāneṣvapi samudāyavyutpattyā bodhāt tatrāpyāvaśyikaiva śaktiriti bhāvaḥ| vastutaḥ padaiḥ padārthabodhavadvākyena vākyārthabodha iti padārthaśaktiḥ padeṣviva vākyārthaśaktirvākye'bhyupeyeti padasphoṭavākyasphoṭau vyavasthitau| anyathā `ghaṭaḥ karmatvamānayanaṃ kṛtiḥ' ityādau tādṛśabyutpattirahitasyāpi bodhaprasaṅgaḥ| `ghaṭamānaya' ityatreva padārthānāmupasthitau satyapi tātparyyajñāne bodhābhāvācca| tatraiva ghaṭakarmakamānayanamiti bodhe ghaṭārthakaprātipadikottaraṃ karmmatvavācakavibhaktestato dhātostata ākhyātasya samabhivyāhāraḥ kāraṇamiti kāryyakāraṇabhāvajñānavato bodhāttajjñānamapi heturiti cettarhi siddho vākyasphoṭaḥ, ghaṭādipadārthabodhe bodhakatārūpapadaśaktijñānakāryyakāraṇabhāvasyeva viśiṣṭavākyārthabodhe padasamabhivyāhārarūpavākyaniṣṭhabodhakatārūpavākyaśaktijñānasyāpi hetutvakalpanāt, arthopasthāpakajñānaviṣayaśabdavṛttijñānakāraṇatvasyaiva śaktitvāt| yuktañcaitat-viṣayatāsambandhena śābdabodhamātre vṛttijñānasya lāghavena hetutvasiddheḥ| vivecitañcaitad bhūṣaṇe| <14.6>vākyaśaktisādhanam nanu vākyārthasyāpūrvatvāt kathaṃ tatra śaktigraha ityāśaṅkayāha-artha iti-vākyasyeti śeṣaḥ| vākyasya vākyārthe viśiṣya śaktayagrahaṇañcettarhi pade'pa samam| pade evānvayāṃśe śaktiriti pakṣe'pi tad‌grahāsambhavastulya ityarthaḥ| yadi ca padaśaktiḥ padārthāṃśe jñātā, anvayāṃśe cājñātopayujyata iti kubjaśaktivādastadā mamāpi vākyasya śaktitarajñātaivopayujyata iti vādābhyupagamastulya iti bhāvaḥ| nanu vṛddhavyavahāraṃ paśyato manasā padārthavadvākyārthe'pi tad‌graha iti cet, tulyamityāha-lakṣaṇāditi-lakṣyate-tarkyate'neneti lakṣaṇam-manastasmāt| apipadaṃ padapadottaraṃ bodhyam| pade'pi lakṣaṇāttadagrahaścettarhyastu vākye'pīti śeṣaḥ| vastutastu samuditārthe viśiṣṭavākyasyaiva prathamaṃ tad‌grahaḥ| āpāpodvāpābhyāṃ paraṃ pratyekaṃ tad‌graha iti bodhyam || 66 || <14.6.1>vākyaśaktau mīmāṃsakādisammatiḥ iyameva mīmāṃsakānāṃ vedāntaikadeśināñca gatirityāha-- sarvatraiva hi(ca) vākyārtho lakṣya eveti ye viduḥ| bhāṭṭāste'pītthamevāhurlakṣaṇāyā grahe gatim || 67 || bhāṭṭāiti-iti tadanuyāyināṃ vācaspati-kalpataruprabhṛtīnāmupalakṣaṇam| nanūktapakṣadvayamanupapannam, utpatte rabhivyaktervaikadā'sambhavena utpannānāmabhivyaktānāṃ varṇasamūharūpapadajñānāsambhavāt| tathāca sutarāṃ tatsamūharūpavākyajñānāsambhava iti cenna, uttaravarṇapratyakṣasamaye tasminnavyavahitottaratvasambandhenopasthitapūrvavarṇāvattvam, tathā taduttarapratyakṣakāle upasthitaviśiṣṭatadvarṇavattvaṃ tasmin sugrahamiti tādṛśānupūrvoghaṭitapadatvasyeva vākyatvasyāpi sugrahatvāt || 67 || <14.7>akhaṇḍavākyasphoṭanirūpaṇam idānīmakhaṇḍapakṣamāha- pade na varṇā vidyante varṇoṣvavayavā naca| vākyāt padānāmatyantaṃ praviveko na kaścana || 68 || pade-pacatītyādau, na varṇāḥ, nāto varṇasamūhaḥ padamiti śeṣaḥ| dṛṣṭāntavyājenāha-varṇeṣviti-ekāraukāraṝkārādivarṇo'ṣvavayavāḥ pratīyamānā api yathā netyarthaḥ| kvacidivetyeva pāṭhaḥ| evaṃ vākye'pyāha-vākyāditi| padānāmapi vākyādvivekaḥ-bhedo nāstītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-vākyam, padañcākhaṇḍameva, natu varṇasamūhaḥ, anantavarṇakalpane mānābhāvāt| tattadvarṇotpādakatvenābhimatavāyusaṃyoganiṣṭhaṃ tattadvarṇajanakatāyāḥ, vyāñjakatāyā vā'vacchedakaṃ vaijātyamādāyaiva kakāro gakāra ityādipratītivailakṣaṇyasambhavāt| spaṣṭaṃ hi bhāmatyām-"tāratvādi vāyuniṣṭhaṃ varṇoṣvāropyate" ityuktaṃ devatādhikaraṇe| nacaivaṃ vāyusaṃyoga eva vācako'pi kiṃ na syāditi vācyam, pratyakṣopalabhyamānakakārādereva vācakatvasyānubhavasiddhatvāt | tathāca vācakatvānyathānupapattyā tadevedaṃ padam, `tadevedaṃ vākyam' so'yaṃ gakāraḥ, iti pratītyā ca sphoṭo'khaṇḍaḥ pratyekaṃ vācakatve pratyekādarthabodhāpattiḥ| samudāyasya tu kramavatāmāśutarotpannānāṃ tathaivābhivyaktānāṃ vā jñānamasambhāvyameva| pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavasaṃskārasahakāreṇaikadā pratyekaṃ vyañjakatvaṃ samuditānāṃ veti vikalpasya sadbhāvāditi cet| ucyate| pratyekameva saṃyogā abhivyañjakāḥ, parantu kecid gatvena, kecidautvena kecidvisargatvenetyanekaiḥ prakāraiḥ| ata eva paryyāyasthaleṣveka eva sphoṭo nānā vā? nādyaḥ, ghaṭapade eva gṛhītaśaktikasya kalaśāderbodhaprasaṅgāt | naca tatparyyāyābhivyakte śaktigrahastatparyyāyaśravaṇe'rthadhīheturiti vācyam, evaṃ sati na dvitīyaḥ, anantapadānāṃ teṣāṃ śaktikalpanāpekṣayā klṛptavarṇeṣveva śaktikalpanasya laghutvāditi parimaloktamapāstam| paryyāyeṣvanekaśaktisvīkārasya sarvasiddhatvāt, tadavacchedakānupūrvyāḥ 68 || <14.7.5>akhaṇḍasphoṭapakṣe śāstraprāmāṇyasamarthanam nanvevaṃ śāstrasyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ, padasyākhaṇḍatvāt, śāstrasya ca prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ padavyutpādanamātrārthatvādityāśaṅkāṃ samādhatte- pañcakośādivattasmāt kalpanaiṣā samāśritā| upeyapratipattyarthā upāyā avyavasthitāḥ || 69 || upeyapratipattyarthā ityantenānvayaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-yathā bhṛguvalyām "bhṛgurvai vāruṇi rvaruṇaṃ brahma pṛṣṭavān| sa uvāca `annam' iti, tasyotpattyādikaṃ bud‌dhvā pṛṣṭe-prāṇamanovijñānā'nandātmakapañcakośottaraṃ " brahmapucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā" iti jñeyaṃ brahma pratipāditam| tatra kośapañcakavyutpādanaṃ śuddhabrahmabodhanāya| yathā vā ānandavallīsthapañcakośavyutpādanaṃ vāstavaśuddhabrahmabodhanāya| evaṃ prakṛtipratyayādivyutpādanaṃ vāstavasphoṭavyutpādanāyaiveti| nanu pratyakṣasya sphoṭasya śravaṇādito'pi bodhasambhavāt na śāstraṃ tadupāya ityata āha-upāyā iti-upāyasyopāyāntarādūṣakatvāt| tathāca vyākaraṇābhyāsajanyajñāne vaijātyaṃ kalpyate| mantrajanyamivārthasmaraṇe| vedāntajanyamiva brahmajñāne| tasya ca jñānasya yajñādīnāmantaḥkaraṇaśuddhāviva śarīrādiśuddhāvupayogaḥ, sākṣātparamparayā vā svargamokṣādihetutvañca| taduktaṃ vākyapadīye- tad‌dvāramapavargasya vāṅmalānāṃ cikitsitam| pavitraṃ sarvavidyānāmadhividyaṃ prakāśate|| idamādyaṃ padasthānaṃ siddhisopānaparvaṇām| iyaṃ sā mokṣamāṇānāmajihmā rājapaddhatiḥ|| atrātītaviparyāsaḥ kevalāmanupaśyati|| iti| nacālīkayā prakṛtipratyayakalpanayā kathaṃ vāstavasphoṭabodhaḥ, tasyā alīkatvāsiddhervakṣyamāṇatvāt| evam`rekhāgavayanyāyaḥ' ādipadena gṛhyate || 69 || nanu sphoṭasya varṇajātīnāñca nityatayā kakāra utpanna iti na syāt| vāyusaṃyoganiṣṭhajāteḥ sphoṭe bhāne kādipratītīnāṃ bhramatvāpattiścetyata āha- kalpitānāmupādhitvaṃ svīkṛtaṃ hi parairapi| svaradairghyādyapi hyanye varṇobhyo'nyasya manvate || 70 || ?B svīkārasthalamāha-svaradairghyādyapīti| ādinotpattivināśasaṃgrahaḥ| udāttatvādi na varṇaniṣṭham, tasyaikatvāt, nityatvācca| tacca, sa evāyamiti pratyabhijñānāt| naca gatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedābhāvastadviṣayaḥ| vyaktayaṃśābhedasyāpi bhāsamānasya vinā bādhakaṃ tyāgāyogat| nacotpattipratitirbādhikā, prāgasattve sati sattvarūpāyā utpattervarṇoṣvanubhavaviruddhatvāt| ata eva varṇamuccārayatīti pratyayaḥ, natūtpādayatīti pratyayovyavahāraśca| uccaritatvañca-tālvoṣṭhasaṃyogādijanyābhivyaktiviśiṣṭatvam| kiñca vyañjakadhvaniniṣṭhotpattyādeḥ paramparayā varṇaniṣṭhatvaviṣayatvenā'pyupatterna sā'tiriktavarṇasādhikā| paramparayā varṇāniṣṭhatvābhyupagamācca na bhramatvam| sākṣātsambandhāśe bhrama ityaviśiṣyate| tadapi so'yamityatra vyaktayabhedāṃśe tava bhramatvavattulyam| parantu mamātiriktavarṇatatprāgabhāvadhvaṃsakalpanā neti lāghavamatiricyate| naca varṇasthale dhvanisattve mānābhāvaḥ, tadutpādakaśaṅkhādyabhāvena tadasambhavaśceti vācyam, kakārādhuccāraṇasthale tattatsthānasya jihvāyā īṣadantarapāte varṇānutpatterdhvanyutpatteśca darśanāt, jihvābhighātajavāyukaṇṭhasaṃyogāderdhvānijanakatvalpanāt| tasya ca varṇotpattisthale'pi sattvāttavaiva pratibandhyapratibandhakabhāvakalpanā niṣpramāṇikī syāditi viparītagaupavam| evaṃ parasparavirodhādudāttatvānudāttatvahvasvatvadīrghatvādikamapi na varṇatiṣṭhaṃ yuktamiti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ| evañcotpattyādipratītīnāṃ tatpramātvasya ca nirvāhaḥ paroṣamapi samāna iti pratibandyaivottaramiti bhāvaḥ || 70 || itthañca pañcadhā vyaktisphoṭāḥ| <14.8> jātisphoṭanirūpaṇam jātisphoṭamāha-- śakyatva3 iva śaktatve jāterlāghavamīkṣyatām| aupādhiko vā bhedo'stu varṇānāṃ tāramandavat || 71 || ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-varṇāstāvadāvaśyakāḥ| uktarītyā ca `so'yaṃ gakāraḥ' itivat, yo'yaṃ gakāraḥ śrutaḥ so'yaṃ hakāra ityapi syāt, sphoṭasyaikatvāt, gakāro'yaṃ na hakāra ityanāpatteśca| kiñca sphoṭe gatvādyabhyupeyam, na vā ? ādye tadeva gakāro'stu| varṇanityatāvādibhiratiriktagatvānaṅgīkārāt| tathācātiriktasphoṭakalpane eva gaupavam| antye-gakārādipratītivirodhaḥ| vāyusaṃyogavṛtti, dhvanivṛtti vā vaijātyamāropya tathā pratyaya iti cenna, pratītervinā bādhakaṃ bhramatvāyogāta| astu vā vāyusaṃyoga eva gakāro'pi| tasyātīndriyatvaṃ doṣa iti ceddharmavadupapatteriti kṛtaṃ sphoṭena| tasmāt santyeva varṇāḥ, parantu na vācakāḥ, gauravāt, ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena jātereva vācyatvavadvācakasyāpi yuktatvācca| idaṃ haripadamityanugatapratītyā haryupasthititvāvacchedena haripadajñānatvena hetutvāttadavacchedakatayā ca jātiviśeṣasyāvaśyakalpyatvāt| naca varṇānupūrvyaiva pratītyavacchedakatvayornirvāhaḥ, ghaṭaghaṭatvāderapi saṃyogaviśeṣaviśiṣṭamṛdākārādibhiścānyathāsiddhayāpatteḥ| tasmāt sā jātireva vācikā, tādātmyenāvacchedikā ceti| nanu saro rasa ityādau tayorjātyoḥ sattvādarthabodhabhedo na syādityata āha-aupādhiko veti| vā tvarthe | upādhirānupūrvvī, saiva jātiviśeṣābhivyañjiketi bhedaḥ karaṇībhūtajñānasyeti nātiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| upādhiprayuktajñānavailakṣaṇye dṛṣṭāntamāha-varṇānāmiti || 71|| nanu jāteḥ pratyekaṃ varṇoṣvapi sattvāt pratyekādarthabodhāpattiḥ syādityata āha anekavyaktayabhivyaṅgyā jātiḥ sphoṭa iti smṛtā| kaiścat vyaktaya evāsyā dhvanitvena prakalpitāḥ ||72 || anekābhirvarṇavyaktibhirabhivyaktaiva jātiḥ sphoṭa iti smṛtā| yogārthatayā bodhiketi yāvat| etena sphoṭasya nityatvātsarvadārthabodhāpattirityapāstam| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ - yadyapi varṇasphoṭapakṣe uktadoṣo'sti| tathāpi padavākyapakṣayorna, tatra tasyā vyāsajyavṛttitvasya dharmigrāhakamānasiddhatvāditi kaiścit vyaktayo dhvanaya eva dhvanivarṇayorbhedābhāvādityabhyupeyante iti śeṣārthaḥ| uktaṃ hi kāvyaprakāśe-"budhairvaiyākaraṇauḥ pradhānībhūtasphoṭarūpavyaṅgayavyañjakasya śabdasya dhvaniriti vyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ" iti || 72 || <14.8.2>jātinirūpaṇam nanu kā sā jātistatrāha- satyāsatyau tu yau bhāgau pratibhāvaṃ vyavasthitau| satyaṃ yattatra sā jātirasatyā vyaktayo matāḥ || 73 || pratibhāvam-pratipadārtham| satyāṃśo jātiḥ, asatyā vyaktayaḥ| tattad‌vyaktiviśiṣṭabrahmaiva jātiriti bhāvaḥ| uktañca kaiyaṭena "asatyopādhyavacchinnaṃ brahmatatvaṃ dravyaśabdavācyamityarthaḥ" iti| "brahmatattvameva śabdasvarūpatayā bhāti" iti ca | kathaṃ tarhi, brahmadarśane ca gotvādijāterapyasatvādanityatvam, "ātmaivedaṃ sarvam' iti śrutivacanāditi kaiyaṭaḥ saṅgacchatām| avidyā āvidyako dharmaviśeṣo veti pakṣāntaramādāyeti draṣṭavyam || 73 || tameva satyāṃśe spaṣṭayati- itthaṃ niṣkṛṣyamāṇaṃ yacchabdatattvaṃ nirañjanam| brahmaivetyakṣaraṃ prāhustasmai pūrṇātmane namaḥ || 74 || ayamarthaḥ-"nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti śrutisiddhā dvayī sṛṣṭiḥ| tatra rūpasyeva nāmno'pi tadeva tattvam| prakriyāṃśastvavidyāvijṛmbhaṇamātram| uktañca vākyapadīye- śāstreṣu prakriyābhedairavidyaivopavarṇyate| samārambhastu bhāvānāmanādi brahma śāśvatam || iti || brahmaivetyanena "atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayañjyotiḥ" "tameva bhāntamanubhāti sarvam" " tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti" iti śrutisiddhasvaparaprakāśatvaṃ sūcayan sphuṭatyartho'smāditi sphoṭa iti yaugikasphoṭaśabdābhidheyatvaṃ sūcayati| nirvighnapracārāyānte maṅgalaṃ stutinatirūpamāha-pūrṇātmane ityādinā || 74 || aśeṣaphaladātāramapi sarveśvaraṃ gurum| śrīmadbhūṣaṇasāreṇa bhūṣaye śeṣabhūṣaṇam || 1 || bhaṭṭojīdīkṣitaiḥ śreṣṭhairnirmitāḥ kārikāḥ śubhāḥ| kauṇḍabhaṭṭena vyākhyātāḥ kārikāstāḥ suvistaram || 2 || iti śrīmatpadavākyapramāṇapārāvārīṇadhurīṇaraṅgojibhaṭṭā'tmajakauṇḍabhaṭṭakṛte vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāre sphoṭavādaḥ | samāpto'yaṃ granthaśca ||
